snippet.title: Creating a Cozy Baking Game! | Madame Fifi's Bakery
snippet.description:
Hi there! We are CozyCat Games, a team of four women creating a relaxing game as our final project for our video game design program!
Today, we are revealing our cozy baking game, Madame Fifi's Bakery! We are currently in development in preparation for our Kickstarter campaign this coming June ~ 


TikTok |  tiktok.com/@cozycat.games
Instagram |  instagram.com/cozycat.games
Steam | https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963260/Madame_Fifis_Bakery/
Kickstarter | https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madamefifisbakery/madame-fifis-bakery?ref=discovery
Website | www.madamefifisbakery.com
Cats' Artstation | https://catland.artstation.com/

Thank you so much for your support, your feedback is always incredibly valuable to us!

Email us at contactcozycatgames@gmail.com ~
